title: 6.19.3 Lab: Bring the wall down
description: A wall of blocks, each with its own hit count. Knock them out one shot at a time.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The wall stands. Stones pass through it.

steps.title: Add the hit loop
steps.instructions: Every shot against every block, one hit off the block, the shot removed on the frame it hits.

steps.title: Clear the spent
steps.instructions: Remove a block at 0 from the screen and from `blocks`, in a backwards loop.
hints: A stone that keeps hitting the same block means the shot is not removed.

requirements.title: A hit takes one off
requirements.description: The block's count is decremented under an overlap test. Help: 6.19.1 (Reading: Blocks that fall)

requirements.title: The shot leaves
requirements.description: The shot is deleted and spliced on the hit. Help: 6.19.1 (Reading: Blocks that fall)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Bring the wall down". The task: put a wall of blocks with per-block hit counts against the shots, remove the shot on the hit, and sweep spent blocks out of both places. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Per-block budget
rubric.description: Each block has its own count.

rubric.title: One hit per shot
rubric.description: The shot leaves when it hits.
